mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT e.* FROM exam e INNER JOIN course_selection cs ON e.course_id = cs.course_id AND cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.semester = #{semester} AND cs.status = 1 WHERE e.semester = #{semester} ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.start_time

SELECT er.seat_no, er.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, er.classroom_id, cr.classroom_name FROM exam_room er LEFT JOIN student s ON er.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON er.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id WHERE er.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY er.classroom_id, er.seat_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_room (exam_id, classroom_id, seat_no, student_id) VALUES (#{examId}, #{classroomId}, #{seatNo}, #{studentId})
INSERT INTO invigilation (exam_id, teacher_id, classroom_id, duty) VALUES (#{examId}, #{teacherId}, #{classroomId}, #{duty})
mapper.select: SELECT i.invigilation_id, i.exam_id, i.teacher_id, i.classroom_id, i.duty, e.exam_date, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.exam_name FROM invigilation i JOIN exam e ON i.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE i.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.start_time
